name: init
js: (() => { const d = document.getElementById('setupDialog'); if (d && d.open) d.close(); window.GMMC.newMap('template'); const m = window.GMMC.getMap(); return { lines: m.lines.length, item: !!document.getElementById('gtfsExportItem'), api: typeof window.GMMCGtfsExport.build }; })()

name: files
js: (() => { const f = window.GMMCGtfsExport.files(); const o = {}; for (const k in f) o[k] = f[k].split('\r\n').length - 2; return o; })()

js: (() => { const m = window.GMMC.getMap(); const id = Object.keys(m.stations)[0]; const old = m.stations[id].name; m.stations[id].name = 'A "quoted", name\nline'; const f = window.GMMCGtfsExport.files()['stops.txt']; m.stations[id].name = old; return f.includes('"A ""quoted"", name\nline"'); })()
